themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems to achieve research objectives.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools and research related to generating, reviewing, and debugging code, acting as assistants for software developers.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses articles discussing various AI-powered tools used for conducting research across different domains, including platforms and functionalities.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Explores the development, capabilities, limitations, and user interactions with AI chatbots for information retrieval, assistance, and more.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, test, and evaluate the performance, accuracy, and usefulness of different AI tools and models.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, employment, skills requirements, and the overall structure of the workforce.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI capabilities for condensing large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for easier understanding.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the use of AI-generated personas or simulated users for testing and research purposes, often compared to human participants.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications in the design process, from concept generation and UI design to aesthetic evaluation and workflow optimization.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Articles about AI's ability to create various forms of content, including text, images, and potentially other media, for design and research outputs.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
